title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Synapse Workspace Module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-synapseworkspace'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.
prerequisites: storage data lake gen 2 file system

aad_admin.type: map(object({ login = string object_id = string tenant_id = string }))
aad_admin.description: (Optional) A aad_admin block as defined below. object({ login = "(Required) The login name of the Azure AD Administrator of this Synapse Workspace." object_id = "(Required) The object id of the Azure AD Administrator of this Synapse Workspace." tenant_id = (Required) The tenant id of the Azure AD Administrator of this Synapse Workspace. })

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

azure_devops_repo.type: object({ account_name = string branch_name = string last_commit_id = string project_name = string repository_name = string root_folder = string tenant_id = string })
azure_devops_repo.description: (Optional) A azure_devops_repo block as defined below. object({ account_name = "(Required) Specifies the Azure DevOps account name." branch_name = "(Required) Specifies the collaboration branch of the repository to get code from." last_commit_id = "(Optional) The last commit ID." project_name = "(Required) Specifies the name of the Azure DevOps project." repository_name = "(Required) Specifies the name of the git repository." root_folder = "(Required) Specifies the root folder within the repository. Set to / for the top level." tenant_id = "(Optional) the ID of the tenant for the Azure DevOps account." })

cmk_key_name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

compute_subnet_id.description: (Optional) Subnet ID used for computes in workspace Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

customer_managed_key.description: (Required) An customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." })

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

github_repo.type: object({ account_name = string branch_name = string last_commit_id = string repository_name = string root_folder = string git_url = string })
github_repo.description: (Optional) A azure_devops_repo block as defined below. object({ account_name = "(Required) Specifies the GitHub account name." branch_name = "(Required) Specifies the collaboration branch of the repository to get code from." last_commit_id = "(Optional) The last commit ID." repository_name = "(Required) Specifies the name of the git repository." root_folder = "(Required) Specifies the root folder within the repository. Set to / for the top level." git_url = "(Optional) Specifies the GitHub Enterprise host name." })

identity.description: (Optional) A Identity block as defined below. object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be associated with this Synapse Workspace.Possible values are SystemAssigned, UserAssigned and SystemAssigned, UserAssigned (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this Synapse Workspace." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

linking_allowed_for_aad_tenant_ids.description: (Optional) Allowed AAD Tenant Ids For Linking.

managed_resource_group_name.description: (Optional) Workspace managed resource group. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

spark_pools.type: map(object({ node_size_family = string node_size = string node_count = optional(number, null) #"Cannot set both node_count and autoscale_max/min_node_count." cache_size = optional(number, null) compute_isolation_enabled = optional(bool, false) dynamic_executor_allocation_enabled = optional(bool, false) min_executors = optional(number, null) max_executors = optional(number, null) session_level_packages_enabled = optional(bool, false) spark_log_folder = optional(string, "/logs") spark_events_folder = optional(string, "/events") spark_version = optional(string, "3.4") autoscale_max_node_count = optional(number, 5) #"Cannot set both node_count and autoscale_max/min_node_count." autoscale_min_node_count = optional(number, 3) #"Cannot set both node_count and autoscale_max/min_node_count." autopause_delay_in_minutes = optional(number, null) requirements_content = optional(string, null) requirements_filename = optional(string, null) spark_config_content = optional(string, null) spark_config_filename = optional(string, null) }))
spark_pools.description: "(Optional) Map containing Spark Pool Objects." map(object({ node_size_family = (Required) The kind of nodes that the Spark Pool provides. Possible values are HardwareAcceleratedFPGA, HardwareAcceleratedGPU, MemoryOptimized, and None. node_size = (Required) The level of node in the Spark Pool. Possible values are Small, Medium, Large, None, XLarge, XXLarge and XXXLarge. node_count = (Optional) The number of nodes in the Spark Pool. Exactly one of node_count or auto_scale must be specified. cache_size = (Optional) The cache size in the Spark Pool. compute_isolation_enabled = (Optional) Indicates whether compute isolation is enabled or not. Defaults to false. dynamic_executor_allocation_enabled = (Optional) Indicates whether Dynamic Executor Allocation is enabled or not. Defaults to false. min_executors = (Optional) The minimum number of executors allocated only when dynamic_executor_allocation_enabled set to true. max_executors = (Optional) The maximum number of executors allocated only when dynamic_executor_allocation_enabled set to true. session_level_packages_enabled = (Optional) Indicates whether session level packages are enabled or not. Defaults to false. spark_log_folder = (Optional) The default folder where Spark logs will be written. Defaults to /logs. spark_events_folder = (Optional) The Spark events folder. Defaults to /events. spark_version = (Optional) The Apache Spark version. Possible values are 2.4 , 3.1 , 3.2, 3.3, and 3.4. Defaults to 2.4. autoscale_max_node_count = (Optional) The maximum number of nodes the Spark Pool can support. Must be between 3 and 200. autoscale_min_node_count = (Optional) The minimum number of nodes the Spark Pool can support. Must be between 3 and 200. autopause_delay_in_minutes = (Optional) Number of minutes of idle time before the Spark Pool is automatically paused. Must be between 5 and 10080. requirements_content = (Optional) The content of library requirements. requirements_filename = (Optional) The name of the library requirements file. spark_config_content = (Optional) The contents of a spark configuration. spark_config_filename = (Optional) The name of the file where the spark configuration content will be stored. }))

sql_aad_admin.type: map(object({ login = string object_id = string tenant_id = string }))
sql_aad_admin.description: (Optional) A sql_aad_admin block as defined below. object({ login = "(Required) The login name of the Azure AD Administrator of this Synapse Workspace SQL." object_id = "(Required) The object id of the Azure AD Administrator of this Synapse Workspace SQL." tenant_id = "(Required) The tenant id of the Azure AD Administrator of this Synapse Workspace SQL." })

sql_administrator_login.description: (Optional) Specifies The login name of the SQL administrator.If this is not provided aad_admin or customer_managed_key must be provided.

sql_administrator_login_password.description: (Optional) The Password associated with the sql_administrator_login for the SQL administrator.If this is not provided aad_admin or customer_managed_key must be provided.

sql_identity_control_enabled.description: (Optional) Are pipelines (running as workspace's system assigned identity) allowed to access SQL pools

storage_data_lake_gen2_filesystem_id.description: (Required) Specifies the ID of storage data lake gen2 filesystem resource.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Azure Synapse Workspace.

name.description: The Name of the Azure Synapse Workspace.

resource.description: The Resource of the Azure Logic App Workflow

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Synapseworkspace' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
